install.notes: README.md:25 states Python 3.8+. setup.py:11 and :17 list numpy, matplotlib, gymnasium and pygame; the environment also imports scipy (navigation2d.py:9-10), and scipy, pygame and matplotlib are imported by the environment module. The gate and the fake backend need none of them: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package. Install the upstream only to serve the driver on the real environment (backend sim), which was not run: its default map_filepath does not match the data in the clone (navigation2d.py:22).
